title: Microcosm

inlines.v: MIC'ROCOSM, noun [Gr. small, and world.] Literally, the little world; but used for man, supposed to be an epitome of the universe or great world. Microcosmic salt, a triple salt of soda, ammonia and phosphoric acid, obtained from urine.
